_notes.authority: Normative for event content. Governed by MECHANICS.md v2.0 §3.1.
_notes.voice: Second person, present tense, mercantile. The event describes a transaction someone is offering. It never describes your feelings about it. Option labels are imperative. Stakes are stated flatly and completely.
_notes.draw: Events draw without replacement within a run, from the run seed's event stream. `acts` gates eligibility.
_notes.structure: Every event offers 2-3 options. At least one is always non-destructive, but it need not be free.
_notes.no_hidden_odds: An event never hides its odds. The `stake` line states the full consequence including the failure branch. Concealed risk is what modifiers and relics are for; an event that lies breaks the contract that makes the other systems readable.
_notes.v2_rescale: All bankroll values rescaled for a run-long bankroll starting at 12, capped at 24. A swing of 3 bankroll is now large. Gold values rescaled against shop prices of 60/110/180.
_notes.slot_pressure: With 5 relic slots, relic-destroy options are no longer purely punitive. A full board makes 'lose a relic' a cost the player may actively want to pay.

effect_vocabulary.bankroll_delta: int. Capped at 24. Cannot reduce below 1 outside of a lethal word failure.
effect_vocabulary.relic_grant: { rarity, choose: bool, count: int }. Triggers the full-board destroy flow if slots are full.
effect_vocabulary.word_challenge: { limit, on_success: effect[], on_failure: effect[] } — the next word must fall within `limit` guesses.
effect_vocabulary.map_skip: { nodes: int } — skips nodes and their rewards, including their shops.
effect_vocabulary.slot_delta: int. Permanent change to relic slot count for the rest of the run.

events.name: THE WAGER
events.prose: A ledger is pushed across the table. The next word is already chosen. Sign, and it must fall in two guesses.

options.label: SIGN THE LEDGER
options.stake: SOLVE IN 2 → +120g · FAIL → LOSE A RANDOM RELIC

options.label: PAY THE CLERK 60g
options.stake: SEE THE FIRST LETTER OF EVERY REMAINING WORD THIS ACT

events.name: THE PAWNBROKER
events.prose: He does not ask what your relics do. He weighs them, quotes a number, and waits. The shelf behind him is covered.

options.label: SELL ONE
options.stake: CHOOSE A RELIC → +140g. BETTER THAN THE SHOP PAYS.

options.label: BUY OFF THE SHELF
options.stake: −140g → ONE RARE RELIC, UNSEEN UNTIL TAKEN

events.name: THE FAST
events.prose: There is a word here. You are permitted not to look at it. The permission has a price and the word has no reward.

options.label: GO HUNGRY
options.stake: −2 BANKROLL · THE NEXT WORD IS SKIPPED. NO GOLD, NO SHOP.

events.name: THE ARCHIVIST
events.prose: She will not trade. She will only burn. Give her something that works and she opens two drawers you have not earned.

options.label: FEED THE FIRE
options.stake: DESTROY ONE RELIC → DRAW 2 RARE, KEEP 1

events.name: THE INFIRMARY
events.prose: Beds, and a board of names. The surgeon counts what you carry rather than what you are worth.

events.name: THE GLUTTON
events.prose: It has already chosen. It is telling you as a courtesy, and the courtesy is the only part you can decline.

events.name: THE MIRROR-MAKER
events.prose: Two words, one bankroll, and a rate of exchange he does not intend to repeat.

options.label: TAKE BOTH
options.stake: NEXT WORD IS A MIRROR → CLEAR IT FOR +180g AND A RARE RELIC

events.name: THE UNDERTAKER
events.prose: He is early, and he says so. The arrangement is prepaid or it is not an arrangement.

options.label: SETTLE THE ACCOUNT
options.stake: −160g → THE NEXT TIME YOUR BANKROLL HITS ZERO, IT RETURNS TO 6. ONCE.
options.engine_note: Resolves after the emergency-purchase offer and before RL.30 Ouroboros. A player holding both keeps both.

events.name: THE LIAR'S BARGAIN
events.prose: Everything it tells you from here will be almost true. It is very clear about this, which is the only honest thing in the room.

options.label: ACCEPT THE TERMS
options.stake: LIAR LETTER ON EVERY WORD THIS ACT → ONE BOSS RELIC NOW
options.balance_flag: The largest single swing in the pool, deliberately. A player holding RL.29 The Mask takes it for free. Watch take-rate and post-take win-rate; if Mask-holders take it above 90% and win above 60%, gate it behind not holding Mask or drop the reward to RARE.

events.name: THE SHORTCUT
events.prose: A door in the wall of the act. It opens onto the boss and nothing in between.

options.label: TAKE THE DOOR
options.stake: SKIP 2 NODES, THEIR GOLD AND THEIR SHOPS · KEEP THE BANKROLL YOU DID NOT SPEND

options.label: READ THE WALL
options.stake: −40g → SEE THE REST OF THE ACT MAP IN FULL

events.name: THE FOUNDLING
events.prose: A basket, three bottles, and a note explaining what the third one costs.

options.label: TAKE ALL THREE
options.stake: 3 CONSUMABLES · LOCKED KEY ON YOUR NEXT 3 WORDS
options.engine_note: Consumable slots cap at 2. A third grant overflows and is lost; the option text must say so at point of choice.

events.name: THE COMPOSITOR
events.prose: He resets the type for the rest of the act. He will not tell you whether the new setting is kinder, because he does not know either.

options.label: RESET THE TYPE
options.stake: REROLL EVERY MODIFIER ON THE REST OF THE ACT. IT MAY GET WORSE.

options.label: PAY HIM TO STOP
options.stake: −120g → CLEAR EVERY MODIFIER ON THE REST OF THE ACT

events.name: THE SIXTH SHELF
events.prose: An empty shelf, already dusted, already yours if you want it. The dust is the price.
events.design_note: The only source of a sixth slot in the game. Deliberately expensive and deliberately singular — it makes the 5-slot cap feel like a rule with one exception rather than an arbitrary limit.
